title: Root response advertises docs even when API docs are disabled
reasoning: The GET / JSON response always includes a /docs link, but the FastAPI app disables /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json when settings.enable_api_docs is false. In that configuration, the root endpoint returns a link that 404s, which makes the service metadata inaccurate.
reproduction: Start the app with enable_api_docs disabled and without a built frontend, request GET /, then request the advertised /docs URL; the root response still advertises /docs even though FastAPI did not register it.
recommendation: Make the root response conditional on settings.enable_api_docs, either omitting the docs field or setting it to null/another available endpoint when docs are disabled.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for GET /, and there is no evidence of coverage for the enable_api_docs=false configuration.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a TestClient test that imports/constructs the app with API docs disabled and no frontend build, asserts GET / does not advertise /docs, and asserts /docs is not registered.
minimumFixScope: Update only the root handler response in app/main.py and add focused tests for docs enabled/disabled behavior.
